title: When estimates change
hook: An estimate depends on the assumptions used.

knows: Fossils and models can supply evidence about the past.
doesNotKnow: At a fixed density of 1 mass unit per cubic unit, the two stipulated volumes yield masses of 2 and 3 units. The shapes illustrate an assumption sensitivity, not the measured mass of a real dinosaur.

misconception: A body-mass estimate is independent of the assumed body volume.
objective: A toy reconstruction keeps its assumed density fixed but increases the body volume from 2 to 3 cubic units. What happens to modeled mass?

claims.text: Recall: At fixed density in the same model, what does a larger reconstructed volume imply for the calculated mass? Mass equals density multiplied by volume in the stipulated model.
